productionWitness.caller: ApprovedHomeCalendar:65 and HomeActivity:3097 call CalendarFeed.read; CalendarFeedReader invokes actual parse. PhotoFrameController:2232 calls CalendarFeed.fetch through the same reader/parser.
productionWitness.baseline: DTSTART UTC/TZID/floating resolves to an instant in parseDt, but PreparedEvent retains only that instant. expandRecurrence then creates main/weekStart calendars in device zone; non-Z/date UNTIL also uses device zone.
productionWitness.concreteExample: New York device, DTSTART:20260307T120000Z with FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=3. UTC series must retain March7/8/9 12:00Z; baseline device-local Calendar.add crosses New York DST and advances March8/9 at 11:00Z.
productionWitness.candidate: Actual accepted ParsedDateTime supplies its zone with start/allDay to PreparedEvent. Evaluation passes that private per-event zone into recurrence calendars and non-Z/date UNTIL; absolute Event API remains unchanged.
